channel.title: Coach Narender
channel.description: Notes from Narender Singh on training at home in Gurgaon.

item.title: Dizzy or exhausted when starting a workout
item.description: Dizzy or exhausted when starting a workout means stop and sit. Sleep, food, and a doctor come before any harder set. Here is the order I use.

item.title: Does sweating mean a good workout
item.description: Does sweating mean a good workout? No. Sweat shows your body is cooling itself. Here is what to judge a session by instead, from a strength coach.

item.title: Lower back pain from a desk job, and when to see a doctor
item.description: Lower back pain from a desk job often settles in a few weeks. The warning signs that need a doctor, how to sit, and what is safe to try first.

item.title: Mobility before heavy lifting on a desk-job week
item.description: Mobility before heavy lifting is the order I use for a stiff desk week. Imbalance first, about 10 minutes of prep, then load, with a reason for each move.

item.title: Neck pain from laptop work between meetings
item.description: Neck pain from laptop work is often the head stuck in one place. Warning signs that need a doctor, then the posture checks that fit a gap between calls.

item.title: How much protein for people who sit all day in India
item.description: Protein for people who sit all day: what ICMR recommends per kilo, why quality matters more than grams, and how to build a better office lunch.

item.title: Strength training for busy professionals in 3 hours a week
item.description: Strength training for busy professionals can fit in about 3 hours a week. How I split it, what WHO asks of adults, and where walking fills the gap.

item.title: Why fitness plans fail for busy people, and what holds up
item.description: Why fitness plans fail for busy people: the plan asks for more than a stressful week gives. Fixed days, short sessions and a small start hold up better.

item.title: Why generic workout plans fail and what to ask instead
item.description: Why generic workout plans fail. A copied list never asked about your joints, medicines or week. What a good plan should ask before your first set.

item.title: Winded climbing stairs after 35, and what I check first
item.description: Winded climbing stairs after 35 can be the cost of a hard flight of steps, or a reason to see a doctor before you train. Here is how I sort that.
